summary: Sprint M19 · Tournament Workspace Overhaul — end-to-end backend + frontend testing. All 12 requested scenarios verified. 20/20 pytest cases pass. Frontend flows (hub default filter, 11-card type picker, create+detail, 5-phase progress stepper, 8 setup boxes, match calendar CRUD + lock, receipts, financial summary, closure letter, subtab regression, tournament_type_code persistence) all work as specified. No blocking issues. One minor UX/test race noted around Financial Summary loading placeholder.

integration_issues.issue:
When the Financial Summary panel is first opened, it briefly renders a placeholder
Loading financial summary…
using the SAME testid as the loaded panel. `summary-variance` only appears after the GET /financial-summary API response resolves (~500ms-1s). Not a functional bug — but tests/automation must wait for `summary-variance` (not just `panel-financial-summary`) to appear. Optional fix: give the loading placeholder a different testid (e.g. `panel-financial-summary-loading`).

issues: Recurring React hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Same finding as iter33 — the Emergent visual-editor is injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> tags in TournamentCreateModal step-2 selects. Not app-code fault but pollutes console.

action_items: (Optional) Give the FinancialSummaryPanel loading placeholder a distinct testid like `panel-financial-summary-loading` so automation can distinguish the two render states.

(Minor spec note) TournamentSubTabs labels the 4th tab 'Reimbursement' but the review-request wording says 'Claim'. Functionally identical (routes correctly). Consider aligning label if the spec is strict.
critical_code_review_comments: tournament_workspace.py:174 — PATCH /calendar-lock uses a query parameter (`?locked=true`) instead of a JSON body. Works but slightly inconsistent with the other PATCH endpoints in the module which use Pydantic bodies. Consider promoting to a `CalendarLockPayload` body-model for consistency.

TournamentDetail.jsx:194 — box-input-vars opens /finance instead of an inline 'input variables' panel. The spec says 'clicking a box either deep-links to an existing screen (squad/finance) or expands an inline panel'. This is acceptable per spec but the note 'Not filled' on the box will never toggle to 'set' unless input_variables is patched from the finance screen. Confirm the finance screen actually surfaces the input_variables editor.

TournamentWorkspacePanels.jsx:255 — FinancialSummaryPanel's early-return uses the SAME `panel-financial-summary` testid as the fully-loaded panel (bad for testability). Either rename or add data-loading attribute.
TournamentWorkspacePanels.jsx:33,42,171 — Uses window.confirm/alert in a modern SPA. Consider a heritage-styled confirmation dialog for consistency with the rest of the app (not blocking, purely UX).

TournamentCreateModal.jsx:298,322 — inline React children of <option> from the visual-editor cause console warnings. If Emergent visual editor cannot be disabled for <option>, wrap options in a fragment via createPortal or use a headless Select (shadcn) to avoid raw <option>.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint M19 complete and fully verified end-to-end. Scenario-by-scenario results: (1) HUB DEFAULT — Live chip active by default (bg-mpca-green-dark applied), 2 live rows (In_Progress + Squad_Selection), All grows to 7. (2) TYPE PICKER — 11 cards render with all expected data-testid codes. Clicking bcci_staging → Step 2 subtitle mentions 'BCCI Domestic Tournament (Staging)', back-to-picker returns to Step 1. (3) CREATE — inter_div tournament created with DIV-IND host and 2026-03-10/15 dates, modal closes, row appears in list, clicking navigates to /tournaments/{id}. (4) PROGRESS BAR — tournament-progress renders with 12% & 'Current Phase: setup'; all 5 phase pills present; clicking setup reveals sub-steps created/input_vars/accepted/calendar (created=done, others=pending on fresh tournament). (5) SETUP BOXES — all 8 present and clickable; calendar/receipts/summary/closure open inline panels; input-vars/squad/budget/invoices deep-link correctly. (6) MATCH CALENDAR CRUD — add-match form works, 2 matches added (match-row-0, match-row-1), calendar-lock-btn flips to calendar-unlock-btn, match-delete-* buttons disappear after lock. (7) PROGRESS RE-DERIVATION — after reload, progress-step-calendar shows Check icon and percent grew from 6% to 12%. (8) RECEIPTS — Sanjeev Dua persona can add receipt (₹50,000 NEFT); receipt-row-0 renders with '₹50,000' formatted. (9) FINANCIAL SUMMARY — summary-variance shows '₹0' with 'UNDER BUDGET' label (green). (10) CLOSURE LETTER — pre#closure-letter-body contains all 3 required strings including tournament name. (11) SUBTABS regression — all 6 tabs render (labels Overview/Squad Selection/Budget & Finance/Reimbursement/Match Officials/Camps); clicking Squad routes to /selection. (12) TYPE_CODE PERSISTED — GET /api/tournaments/{id} returns tournament_type_code='inter_div'. NOTE: Iter33-reported issue (SelectionConsole locked screen missing subtabs) appears to be FIXED — subtabs now render on the Locked variant.
